note: Synthetic works and funding for samples/export/ (docs/05 §13, docs/09 §11.8). These shapes cannot come from samples/store/: it holds real papers with real UWPR evidence, is rebuilt from live APIs, and the real store contains no retracted work at all. Every title says SAMPLE and every DOI uses the unassigned 10.0000 test prefix, so none of these can be mistaken for a real paper; every synthetic grant's title says SAMPLE or it has none, and its numbers hold a 999 serial or a 2099 contract year, which no funder issues. They are merged with the sample store's works and funding and passed through the same build_export the pipeline uses.
